artifacts.caption: Overarching ThemeGraph architecture separating graph computation from certificate-mediated semantic governance across eight certificate-guarded output entry points.
artifacts.alt_text: Two coupled rails show a computational path from corpus provenance to graph structure and an epistemic path from requested semantics and typed evidence through a certificate-required representation monitor. A blocked bypass depicts the maintained boundary across two nonsemantic structural serializers and six semantic representation or export entry points. Admit, qualify, and refuse certificates jointly govern statement, mark, and requested-claim export.

artifacts.caption: A dependency sequence of design-specific epistemic gates separating correctness, construct/evidence match, persistence, interpretive validity, and human benefit.
artifacts.alt_text: Five distinct gates form a horizontal dependency sequence showing that computational correctness does not imply construct/evidence match, specification persistence, interpretive validity, or human benefit.
